data.title: CertiK Completes Independent Verification of GL1 Self-Assessment Statements
data.description:
CertiK has completed an independent technical verification of self-assessment statements submitted by the XRP Ledger Foundation and Partior for Global Layer One (GL1). According to Odaily, the review covered the “Architecture” and “Resilience” principles in GL1’s Market Infrastructure Toolkit (MI Toolkit), providing financial institutions with additional technical information for assessing the underlying networks.

For financial institutions considering the networks, the review adds evidence to help them understand how the infrastructure operates and assess whether its controls meet their requirements. For network operators, independent technical verification can increase the transparency of self-assessment statements and support them with technical evidence.

data.title: LUKSO Email Recovery Vulnerability Leads to Theft of 1.4 Million LYX From About 300 Accounts
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, attackers exploited a backend vulnerability in LUKSO’s email recovery system overnight from Nov. 17 to 18, gaining control of about 300 Universal Profile accounts and stealing approximately 1.4 million LYX. They moved the tokens to Ethereum through a cross-chain bridge and exchanged them for about 50 ETH on decentralized exchanges, including Uniswap.

LUKSO said the flaw allowed attackers to take control of the recovery service’s own “recovery” Universal Profile and add their control keys to user accounts before transferring assets. The LUKSO blockchain and Universal Profile smart contracts were not affected, and no private keys or seed phrases were exposed. Accounts that did not use email recovery were unaffected. LUKSO has disabled the email recovery system; file-based and device keychain backups remain safe.

Affected users must remove the attackers’ control keys and the malicious “recovery-UP” controller in sequence; revoking permissions alone is insufficient. LUKSO said users can retain their accounts, names, history, and remaining assets after completing the steps. The project is preparing a compensation plan and expects to announce details in the coming weeks.

data.title: Variational Co-Founder Says New Funding Will Expand Swaps and Bring Institutional Derivatives Onchain
data.description:
Variational co-founder Edward Yu said $110 million in new funding will be used mainly to expand the company’s swap business and bring institutional-grade derivatives onchain. According to Odaily, the expansion will raise open interest limits, improve liquidity, add tradable assets and broaden the range of asset classes.

The company’s Pro version will develop a flexible multi-dealer network supporting derivatives that can be settled peer to peer. Variational plans to offer swaps, perpetual contracts, options and other derivatives across thousands of markets. Yu said financial markets will undergo major changes in the coming years.

data.title: Citigroup Cuts Bitcoin and Ethereum Base-Case Targets to $99,532 and $2,838
data.description: According to ChainCatcher citing The Block, Citigroup lowered its base-case price targets for Bitcoin to $99,532 and Ethereum to $2,838 after a further decline in crypto markets. Citi strategist Alex Saunders attributed the cuts to weaker ETF demand, deleveraging in futures markets, a stronger U.S. dollar, rising real yields, and increased stock-market volatility.

data.title: Grayscale Says Bitcoin Volatility Matches U.S. Large-Cap Stocks, Small Allocation Can Improve Portfolio Efficiency
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Grayscale said Bitcoin’s realized volatility has declined significantly over the past decade to about 43%, within the range for U.S. large-cap stocks and below that of roughly 19% of S&P 500 constituents.

Bitcoin has experienced extreme moves in both directions, with momentum concentrating returns and sharp reversals. Its annualized return over the past three years was 60%; excluding its 10 best days would reduce that to 7%, while excluding its 10 worst days would raise it to 197%. Adjusted for volatility, its drawdowns are less extreme than their absolute size suggests. Traditional market factors explain less of Bitcoin’s returns than they do for stocks, bonds and private assets, supporting its role as a portfolio diversifier.

Historical backtests indicate that a small Bitcoin allocation can improve portfolio efficiency without a proportional increase in volatility or maximum drawdown. Bitcoin accounts for about half of return variation in the crypto sector, whose correlations have declined from their peaks as leadership rotates among assets. Grayscale said crypto risk frameworks should reflect the asset class as it exists today, rather than a decade ago.

data.title: Intel’s 18A Process Signs Its First External Customer
data.description:
According to Jin10, Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan said on Wednesday that the company had signed its first external customer for its 18A chip manufacturing process. Speaking at the TomorrowX Summit in Austin, Tan said, “I am personally involved in 18A production, and we have just signed our first customer.” He did not identify the customer.

Intel has viewed the 18A process as key to turning around its business after years of setbacks and low chip yields, as it seeks to become a competitive chip manufacturer for external customers. Intel CTO Ranade later said on social media that the customer had signed up to use Intel’s 18A-P process node, which entered risk production in June.

A report in May said Apple and Intel were nearing an agreement for Intel Foundry Services to produce some chips for Apple devices. Creative Strategies analyst Ben Bajarin said potential customers include Nvidia, Apple, and large hyperscale cloud service providers that design their own custom processors.

data.title: Barclays, Deutsche Bank See Dollar Rally Extending Through 2027
data.description: According to ChainCatcher citing Bloomberg, at least three banks expect the dollar’s rally to continue through 2027, despite concerns that slower AI spending could weaken the currency. The AI boom has prompted global investors to buy U.S. stocks, supporting dollar demand as overseas investors exchange their local currencies to purchase shares in American companies using the technology. Barclays says the U.S. private sector is entering a four-year AI investment cycle. It sees strong U.S. economic performance and the possibility of interest rates staying elevated for longer as favorable conditions for the dollar. The report also discusses Barclays’ and Deutsche Bank’s views on the AI boom and the dollar.

data.title: Ethereum Foundation Sells 1,200 ETH Worth About $2.14 Million
data.description: The Ethereum Foundation exchanged 1,200 ETH, worth about $2.14 million, through CoWSwap for USDS and sUSDS. According to Odaily, it deposited 1.777 million USDS into Sky’s savings contract and received 1.591 million sUSDS. After the transaction, the foundation held 30.78 million sUSDS, worth about $34.47 million, which can earn returns through Sky’s floating savings rate.
